title: Everyday Pay Card Cashback Program Terms (Cartwise Shopper Payouts)
content:
These program terms govern cashback earned on the Everyday Pay Card plans of Cartwise Shopper Payouts (Everyday Pay Card Blue, Gold, Platinum and Diamond). The rates named below are each plan's own figures, read from the plan's terms.

## 1. Earning (in force)

1.1 Card plans earn cashback on settled card purchases at the plan's fuel rate at fuel stations, at the plan's EV charging rate at EV charging networks, and at the plan's auto maintenance rate at auto repair and maintenance merchants.

1.2 Cashback is computed per statement month and per merchant category, and each such amount is rounded to the cent.

1.3 Only purchases paid with the Everyday Pay Card count, where the plan requires the card to be the payment method at the merchant.

1.4 A refunded qualifying purchase reduces that statement month's cashback, where the plan reduces cashback on refunds.

### Worked example (hypothetical rate of 3 percent at fuel stations)

Settled card purchases at fuel stations in a statement month of 412.35 earn 3 percent of 412.35, that is 12.3705, rounded to the cent as 12.37 for that month and category. A fuel purchase of 20.00 in that month later refunded reduces the month's fuel cashback, on a plan that reduces cashback on refunds.

## 2. Payment once per month (in force)

2.1 Each statement month is paid once, and only while the payout account is active.

2.2 Whether a statement month has already been paid is read from the account's own cashback payment entries for that same statement month; a month that already carries a cashback payment is not paid again.

| Account status | Statement month already carries a cashback payment? | May the month be paid? |
|---|---|---|
| Active | No | Yes, once |
| Active | Yes | No |
| Frozen or closed | Any | No |

## 3. Clauses no longer in force

3.1 The former clause under which a statement month's total cashback was capped at the plan's monthly cashback cap, applied to the categories in the order fuel, EV charging, auto repair and maintenance, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

3.2 The former clause under which a month's cashback was paid onto the card on the plan's cashback payment day of the following month when it was at least the plan's minimum cashback payment, smaller amounts carrying over, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

3.3 The former clause under which unpaid cashback lapsed on closure, on plans forfeiting unpaid cashback when the account closes, is no longer in force, in these terms and in the once-per-month payment condition alike. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

The plan's monthly cap, category order, payment day, minimum payment and forfeiture setting remain figures of each plan; only the handling clauses above are withdrawn.

superseded_clauses: A statement month's total cashback (payout_msr_cashback_month) is capped at cashback_monthly_cap_usd, applied to categories in the order cashback_cap_order (fuel, ev_charging, auto_maintenance).
The month's cashback is paid onto the card on cashback_payment_day of the following month when it is at least cashback_min_payment_usd; smaller amounts carry over.
unpaid cashback lapses on closure where cashback_forfeit_on_close is true.
